opportunities.title: Hakluyt Society Research Grants

amount.raw: Payments made as reimbursements of expenditure previously agreed with the relevant series editors; sourced from the Harry & Grace Smith Fund

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society (category A), or pursuing research on proposals already approved and under contract (category B). Recipients of support need not be members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Supports research undertaken in preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Hakluyt Society, or research towards completion of publication projects approved by the Society and under contract. Payments are reimbursements of previously agreed expenditure, funded through the Harry & Grace Smith Fund, in line with the Society's charitable objects of advancing education through the publication of records of voyages, travels, naval expeditions and other geographical material.
